workarounds.symptom: Closing the terminal leaves the WebUI front-end running, and the next launch exits

The shared backend stays running after a completed launch. A closed terminal's output error cannot skip cleanup. (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/829)

workarounds.symptom: BEMACallback breaks when any parameter is frozen
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix BEMACallback when some parameters are frozen. Target files: trl/trainer/callbacks.py, tests/test_callbacks.py. `BEMACallback` keeps only the trainable parameters, but wrote them into the BEMA model by position over all of its parameters. As soon as one parameter is frozen (e.g. the embeddings, or a VLM vision tower), the two lists shift and the first BEMA update crashes (`The size of tensor a (152064) must match the size of tensor b (32)` with the tiny Qwen2). The update now looks up each BEMA parameter by name, with the... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8455)

workarounds.symptom: Setup treats a removed built-in harness as unknown when other connectors are installed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): make local setup and startup reliable. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/setup-destination.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/smoke/setup-no-connector.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/smoke/up-multi-space-render-live.smoke.ts. First-run connector reconciliation can outlast the five-minute provisioner JWT. Broker startup now mints that credential after reconciliation, without changing its lifetime or scope. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7978)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Neo4jTools returns [] when a query fails, so the agent reads an error as "no results"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [fix] Surface Neo4jTools errors instead of returning []. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/neo4j.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_neo4j.py. `Neo4jTools` (`list_labels`, `list_relationship_types`, `get_schema`, `run_cypher_query`) caught all exceptions, logged them, and returned `[]`. Agents could not tell a Cypher/connection failure from a real empty result. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11724)

workarounds.symptom: ToolsAgent V3, @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.agent fail
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(AI Agent Node): Drop chat memory turns with empty content. Drop each chat memory turn that has an empty human or AI message in `loadMemory`, which ToolsAgent V2 and V3 use. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/43935)

workarounds.symptom: Self-update makes a read-only Codex config file writable
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(codex): respect plugin configuration and report setup writes. Target files: extensions/connector-codex/smoke/setup-refresh.smoke.ts, extensions/connector-codex/src/setup.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/setup.ts. Refreshing a stale Codex plugin could replace a read-only `config.toml` with an owner-writable file. The connector now refuses before invoking Codex to change the plugin if the config is read-only. An already-current plugin still needs no native reinstall. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7986)

workarounds.symptom: HTTP Request pagination fails with ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE on HTTP 204 responses
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core, HTTP Request Node): Handle empty response bodies in pagination. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: 环境存在 socks5 代理（ALL_PROXY）时 ov 命令报 unsupported scheme socks5，且配置向导隐藏真实错误
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): support socks5 proxies in the ov HTTP client (#7802). Target files: crates/ov_cli/src/base_client.rs, crates/ov_cli/Cargo.toml. The `ov` CLI builds its reqwest client without the `socks` feature. When a socks5 proxy is configured (e.g. `ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:10808`), every request fails with `unsupported scheme socks5`, even though the server is reachable directly and browsers/curl handle the same proxy fine (issue #7802). (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7861)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Microsoft Agent Framework captures empty-message tool exceptions as completed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(maf): preserve empty-message tool failures in captured memory. Target files: integrations/frameworks/microsoft-agent-framework/src/openviking_agent_framework/provider.py, integrations/frameworks/microsoft-agent-framework/tests/test_provider.py. MAF turns a tool raising `TimeoutError()` into a function result with `exception=""` and the model-facing output `"Error: Function failed."`. The context provider checks the exception's truthiness and records this failed invocation as `tool_status="completed"`. (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7774)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: rejected vector write is counted as processed — zero-error vector loss with a completed task
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(queue): fail embedding work when vector upsert returns no ID. Target files: openviking/storage/collection_schemas.py, tests/storage/test_collection_schemas.py. An embedding UPSERT or MERGE can receive an empty record ID when the account backend rejects the payload or its adapter returns no IDs. The handler currently records that as successful Work with `vector_written: false`, so the persisted task can finish with zero queue errors despite the missing vector. (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7616)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: BLIP-2 tower/connector LoRA rejects a non-divisible encoder budget
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][LoRA] Allow non-divisible BLIP-2 encoder budgets. Target files: vllm/model_executor/models/blip2.py. BLIP-2 can fail during tower/connector LoRA initialization when the encoder budget is not a multiple of the query tokens per image. This change sizes the wrappers for the number of complete images that fit. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/67271)
